item.title: Tandragee road closed and others badly hit by by floods as police urge caution
item.description: The Armagh Road, Tandragee, is closed between Laurelvale Road and Cordrain Road due to flooding. There is also surface water on Markethill Road, Tandragee. Police are advising road users to exercise due care and attention, and avoid the area if they can.
